```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/constants.R")
source("R/nws.R")
source("R/climate.R")
source("R/outpost_widgets.R")

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)

nws_context <- wmw_nws_context()
forecast <- wmw_nws_forecast_periods(nws_context)
rolling <- wmw_rolling_year_series()

today_period <- forecast[forecast$is_daytime, ]
today_high <- if (nrow(today_period) > 0) today_period$temperature[1] else forecast$temperature[1]
```
